sentences.en: He will have gotten the inspiration from that animated cartoon.
sentences.zh: 他一定是从那部动画片中得到了灵感。

sentences.en: Humans are odd. I'd much rather be a cartoon fox.
sentences.zh: 人类真是奇怪。我宁愿做一只卡通狐狸。

sentences.en: Some people say that cartoons on television are educational in themselves.
sentences.zh: 有些人说电视上的卡通本身就有教育意义

senses.zh: 卡通片，[电影] 动画片；连环漫画
